name: Iran
dossier:
The Iran national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Team Melli, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 20 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from AFC to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Asia's perennial heavyweight, still chasing a first-ever knockout berth.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Iran will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group G and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group G. The connection between Mehdi Taremi and Sardar Azmoun is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Mehdi Taremi - the clinical striker who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Iran are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Iran's 1998 win over the USA in Lyon remains one of football's most politically charged matches ever played.
Iran boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Group stage (multiple).
